blocks.text: When a browser reads a style sheet, it will format the HTML document according to the information in the style sheet.
There are three ways of inserting a style sheet:

items: External CSS - link to an external .css file
Internal CSS - use the <style> element in the head section
Inline CSS - use the style attribute on HTML elements

blocks.text:
With an
external style sheet, you can change the look of an entire website by changing
just one file!

Each HTML page must include a reference to the external style sheet file inside
the <link> element, inside the head section.
